missionInput.ticketText:
INCIDENT TICKET #INC-2401
Reported: 2026-07-14 09:42 UTC
Reporter: EU Customer Success

Summary:
Multiple EU customers report they cannot reach the public API. Browser and CLI clients fail with
"could not resolve host: api.example.com". US customers appear unaffected so far.

Impact:
- EU checkout and partner integrations failing at DNS resolution
- No confirmed application 5xx spike from EU edge yet (clients never connect)

Notes:
- Started around 09:30 UTC
- Internal US monitoring still shows api.example.com healthy
- Please investigate DNS / network path first
